item.title: Trump prepares to address nation on Iran after vowing to end conflict in ‘weeks’
item.summary: The White House promised an “important update” on Iran, in what is set to be the president’s first prime-time address since the U.S. and Israeli assault began.

item.title: Trump attends Supreme Court hearing in unusual role: Silent observer
item.summary: The president’s name did not come up as he watched the arguments over his birthright citizenship executive order from the public viewing gallery.

item.title: Marines scramble to reassure families after report of ICE at boot camp
item.summary: A communications breakdown precipitated an announcement that immigration enforcement will occur at the service’s Parris Island graduation ceremonies in South Carolina, officials said.

item.title: Supreme Court appears skeptical of Trump’s effort to end birthright citizenship
item.summary: The justices appeared poised to turn aside government arguments that the president can deny citizenship to babies born to parents without permanent immigration status.
